inspiration.observed_pattern: A compatibility function maps DATE, DATETIME, and TIME format families plus USA, ISO, and INTERNAL locale names to MariaDB DATE_FORMAT masks.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored schedule-format report. Fixed DATETIME values are formatted through literal GET_FORMAT calls for DATE/ISO, DATETIME/USA, and TIME/JIS branches selected by each schedule ID; the source function body, schema, names, and values are not copied.

fixture_notes: Each schedule row uses a fixed timestamp and one literal GET_FORMAT family/locale pair selected by schedule ID. All combinations are supported MariaDB formats, so the report exercises mask construction and DATE_FORMAT composition without relying on unsupported dynamic GET_FORMAT arguments.
determinism_notes: Schedule IDs, timestamps, format families, and locales are fixed; the output is ordered by the unique schedule ID. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE schedule_formats (schedule_id INT PRIMARY KEY, schedule_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, scheduled_at DATETIME NOT NULL, format_family VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, locale_name VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO schedule_formats VALUES (301, 'morning briefing', '2026-04-05 07:08:09', 'DATE', 'ISO'), (302, 'evening handoff', '2026-04-05 17:18:19', 'DATETIME', 'USA'), (303, 'nightly archive', '2026-04-05 21:22:23', 'TIME', 'JIS')

steps.sql: SELECT schedule_id, schedule_name, CASE schedule_id WHEN 301 THEN GET_FORMAT(DATE, 'ISO') WHEN 302 THEN GET_FORMAT(DATETIME, 'USA') WHEN 303 THEN GET_FORMAT(TIME, 'JIS') END AS format_mask, CASE schedule_id WHEN 301 THEN DATE_FORMAT(scheduled_at, GET_FORMAT(DATE, 'ISO')) WHEN 302 THEN DATE_FORMAT(scheduled_at, GET_FORMAT(DATETIME, 'USA')) WHEN 303 THEN DATE_FORMAT(scheduled_at, GET_FORMAT(TIME, 'JIS')) END AS formatted_value FROM schedule_formats ORDER BY schedule_id
